title: Qualification strategy and torture corpora
summary: NoSQLServer carries a long versioned validation lineage plus SQL feature torture, SQL-92 company smoke, hell corpora and feature-specific regressions. New changes should run the narrow forcing test and the accumulated semantic baselines rather than trusting parser acceptance alone.
invariants: A new parser path needs actual result-state assertions.
Keep wrong-result and execution-error outcomes distinct from unsupported/parse-error baseline classifications.
Do not weaken old oracle-backed/torture regressions to accommodate a new feature.
